en: Conditioned by a state that is neither a cause nor leading to accumulation, a state that is a cause and leading to accumulation arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [results] under the root condition … pe … three under the non-disappearance condition.

Conditioned by a state that is neither a cause nor leading to disintegration, a state that is a cause and leading to disintegration arises by way of the root condition. (Abbreviated. Three [results] under the root condition … pe … three under the non-disappearance condition.
In dependence on a state that is neither a cause nor leading to accumulation or disintegration, a state that is neither a cause nor leading to accumulation or disintegration [arises]…

A non-root phenomenon arises with root condition. Dependent on a non-root phenomenon that leads neither to accumulation nor to dissipation, a non-root phenomenon that leads neither to accumulation nor to dissipation arises with root condition. (Abbreviated. Under root condition there are three;
under predominance condition there are three ... pe ... under non-disappearance condition there are three.
